title: Boot closing and electric boot lid
summary: Feedback centers on the boot lid, especially requests for electric closing or opening and comments about the boot being awkward or hard to shut, while many fragments are too brief or ambiguous to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe overall satisfaction with the car while noting that an electric boot closing button or power boot lid would be a welcome addition.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain that the boot or closures must be shut by hand or slammed, making them awkward to use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the boot, electric boot features, or shutting difficulty, but the fragments often lack enough context for a clear sentiment classification and include at least one unrelated use of the word boot for system startup.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are too short or context-poor to determine sentiment confidently.
The topic includes at least one unrelated fragment about a screen booting up rather than the vehicle boot compartment.
Examples are insufficient to separate comments about manual closing effort, missing electric closing, and boot size into cleaner subtopics.
